punchline: A dying woman whispered that she had spent her whole life thinking something was wrong with her, and her daughter decided not to live the same way.
thirty_sec: Marilyn sat for hours beside her dying mother, reading to her and holding her hand. Before dawn her mother opened her eyes and whispered that all her life she had thought something was wrong with her. Hours later she was gone. Marilyn told teacher Tara Brach it was her mother's parting gift: she did not have to lose her own life that way, and she decided to treat herself with more kindness.
